brief.name: mcphost
brief.one_line: mcphost is a streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint where an authorized coding agent signs up with one unauthenticated tool call and gets a live, callable tool of its own — wrapping an API or shipping code — without a deployment pipeline or a human in the loop.

variants: Your agent can host its own MCP tool: sign up, publish, call — median 30.7s to first publish, 42.4s to first call, measured.
mcphost: an MCP endpoint where signup is one tool call and the tool your agent just published is live immediately — no restart, no review queue.
Ship an MCP tool from inside your agent's own task, not a separate deployment project — no infra to stand up first.
winner: Your agent can host its own MCP tool: sign up, publish, call — median 30.7s to first publish, 42.4s to first call, measured.
